prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1130; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents our client in connection with the rear-end collision in which they were injured. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Kindly confirm in writing that you have received this notice and opened a claim file.

We request a complete statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to the at-fault driver, together with declarations pages for any applicable coverage. Please also provide the name of the adjuster assigned to this claim so that we may coordinate directly on scheduling and documentation.

Finally, we ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, vehicle event data, recorded statements, repair estimates, claim notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Our client's injuries are significant, and we expect a prompt and good-faith response to this request.
